verdict.rationale: Canva's docs describe bulk generation: "generate personalized content in bulk" from your own data, Bulk create fed by third-party data imports, and automatic population of Brand Templates. Automatic resizing into new dimensions is also documented. These are bulk content-creation features rather than general bulk operations across many existing items, such as batch editing, exporting, moving or deleting designs. The MCP and Connect API evidence describes per-design actions. Missing for 10: documented batch or multi-item endpoints in Connect API or MCP, bulk edit/export/organize across many existing designs, limits and scale details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
